purpose: One fixed-base arm, explicit PD, no RL or hardware; uncalibrated numerical validation only

rationale.actuator: IdealPDActuator; identical gains are a diagnostic numerical baseline, not manufacturer data or tuned performance
rationale.armature_and_damping: Added SIM_ONLY inertia floor 0.02; dt*sqrt(Kp/armature)=0.416667; Kd=2*sqrt(Kp*armature)=4. Body CAD mass/inertia remain unchanged
rationale.bounds: 20 Nm and 0.5 rad/s are experiment-only caps overriding invalid USD zero dynamic limits; never hardware specifications
rationale.collisions: Self-collisions enabled; standard joint-connected pair exclusion retained; 1 mm contact skin, restOffset 0; no extra non-adjacent filters
rationale.initial_pose: Chosen only after CPU convex-hull collision checking and limit validation; not justified by vendor demo angles
rationale.gates: Numerical experiment acceptance thresholds, not robot accuracy or hardware safety limits
